module.Title: Store Movement Speed
module.Teaching: The double type stores numbers with decimal places. Movement speed often needs more precision than a whole number.
module.PredictionQuestion: Why use double instead of int?
module.PredictionExplanation: An int cannot represent 2.5, but a double can.
module.DebugPrompt: The variable is declared as int even though the value contains a decimal.
module.RecallPrompt: From memory, create moveSpeed with the value 2.5.
module.PreviewMessage: Movement speed is now represented with decimal precision.
